description: Construction-specialist eval suite for Auricrux. Scores the runtime ConstructionIntelligenceService (corpus search + thinking + chat fallback) against domain questions spanning CSI divisions, OSHA safety, estimating, scheduling, contracts, and code basics. Passing this suite is required evidence before AUX-017/018/019 can move from FAIL/PARTIAL toward PASS.
